pythonFunction.name: verify_pin
pythonFunction.description: Verifies a PIN provided by the customer during the auth-retry flow. Sets auth_status to 'authenticated' or 'unauthenticated' in session state and increments auth_attempt_count. Returns auth_status, auth_attempt_count, and agent_action with next steps. Call this when auth_status is 'unauthenticated' and the customer has provided a PIN. Do NOT call set_session_state for auth_attempt_count separately after calling verify_pin.
